decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to this premium stollen over two seasons and repeated gold-medal recognition gives management strong justification to continue rather than admit error.

This bread remains prominently presented across two years, fits the core bakery range with limited incremental risk, and management can readily justify keeping it as an established extension rather than writing off the launch.

The marzipan stollen is close to the firm's traditional seasonal business and has been maintained on its own page in both years, so sunk effort and public commitment make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
